buildCommand: if [ -d flutter ]; then (cd flutter && git fetch --depth 1 origin 3.41.4 && git checkout -q 3.41.4); else git clone https://github.com/flutter/flutter.git --depth 1 -b 3.41.4 flutter; fi && export PATH="$PWD/flutter/bin:$PATH" && flutter config --enable-web && flutter pub get && flutter build web --release --dart-define=SUPABASE_URL=$SUPABASE_URL --dart-define=SUPABASE_ANON_KEY=$SUPABASE_ANON_KEY --dart-define=RAZORPAY_KEY_ID=$RAZORPAY_KEY_ID
